line.a_zapasy.text: I have my whole winter store! I'll put it away in my hollow.

line.a_nie_mieszcze.text: Oh no! I don't fit into my hollow. Only my head goes in!

line.a_za_mala.text: Your hollow is too small. You have grown, and now you have a big store.

line.a_nowa.text: You need a new hollow, bigger than the old one. Let's look for one in the forest!

line.a_jak.text: But how will we know which hollow is bigger?

line.a_metoda.text: We'll hold the door against each new hollow. If there's a gap all round it, the hollow is bigger. If the door covers the hole and sticks out, it's smaller.

line.b_trzy.text: Look, there are three hollows in these trees.

line.b_najwieksza_nie.text: That one isn't the biggest. Look for the one bigger than all the others.

line.b_sprobuje.text: The biggest! I'll surely fit in. Let me try!

line.b_za_duza.text: Brr! It's too big. The wind blows in and it's cold.

line.b_najmniejsza.text: Now point to the smallest hollow.

line.b_najmniejsza_nie.text: That one isn't the smallest. Look for the one smaller than all the others.

line.b_za_mala.text: This one is too small, even smaller than my old one!

line.b_w_sam_raz.text: Bigger than the old one, and smaller than the huge one. Just right for me!

line.b_myszki.text: A mouse family will move into Squirrel's old hollow. But their box is too small for their things.

line.b_pudelko.text: Point to the bigger box, and the mice will fit.

line.b_pudelko_nie.text: That box is smaller. The mice need a bigger one.

line.b_dziekuja.text: The mice fit into the bigger box and say thank you!

line.b_do_domu.text: I have a new hollow that's just right! Come to my house-warming.

line.p_start.text: Before the house-warming, let's play big and small!

line.p_poloz.text: Let's lay one on the other and see. Which one is bigger?

line.p_wystaje.text: See? The bigger one sticks out all round.

line.p_najwiekszy_nie.text: That apple is smaller. Look for the biggest one.

line.p_cien.text: Point to the pear this shadow belongs to: the big one or the small one.

line.p_cien_nie.text: Look at the shadow again. Is it big or small?

line.p_cien_duzy.text: Yes! It's the big pear's shadow.

line.p_cien_maly.text: Yes! It's the small pear's shadow.

line.p_czapki.text: Three caps: the biggest for Owl, she has the biggest head, the middle one for me, the smallest for Squirrel. Drag each cap.

line.za_duze.text: That cap is too big, it slips off. Try a smaller one.

line.za_duze.sowa.text: That cap is too big, it slips off. Try a smaller one.

line.za_duze.wiewiorka.text: That cap is too big, it slips off. Try a smaller one.

line.za_male.text: That cap is too small. Try a bigger one.

line.za_male.sowa.text: That cap is too small. Try a bigger one.

line.za_male.wiewiorka.text: That cap is too small. Try a bigger one.

line.d_parapetowka.text: Welcome to the house-warming in my new hollow! First I'll put my store on the shelves.

line.d_kubki.text: Tea is ready! Give the big cup to big Fox, and the small one to little Squirrel.

line.d_nie_ten.text: That cup is for someone else. The big one for Fox, the small one for Squirrel.

line.d_pasuje.text: The big cup for big Fox, the small one for little Squirrel. Yum, tea!

line.d_rodzice.text: Compare the whole family's shoes with your parents: lay one on the other. The one that sticks out is bigger!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping me find a hollow! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Squirrel's new hollow. We found it when we compared what is bigger and what is smaller.

line.b_stara_ze_soba.text: We've brought the door from the old hollow. We'll hold it against each new one.

line.a_drzwiczki.text: Your old hollow has a round little door. It fits it exactly. We can't take the hollow, but we can take the door!

line.b_przykladaj.text: Hold the door against each hollow in turn. Drag it onto the hole.

line.b_nastepna.text: Now hold the door against another hollow.

line.b_k_duza.text: Oh, there's a huge gap all round the door! This hollow is much bigger than the old one.

line.b_k_mala.text: The door covers the whole hole and still sticks out. This hollow is smaller than the old one!

line.b_k_srednia.text: There's only a small gap round the door. This hollow is a little bigger than the old one.

line.b_ostatnia_dla.text: Point to the hollow just right for Squirrel, a little bigger than the old one.

line.b_ostatnia_nie.text: Not that one. We're looking for the one where the door left only a small gap.

line.b_przeprowadzka.text: And now, moving day! My store is in two boxes, a big one and a small one. Who will carry the first one?

line.c_nowy_dom.text: Here it is, in this big oak! My new hollow: not too big and not too small, just right.

line.c_zoledzie.text: What a beautiful oak! And so many acorns on it. Squirrel, you'll have plenty for your store.

line.c_zapasy_w_dziupli.text: All my store fits in my hollow, because it's bigger than the old one!

line.b_ja_pierwszy.text: I want to carry the first box! You too? Then let's play rock, paper, scissors. Whoever wins carries the first one.

line.b_kpn_ty.text: Your win! You carry the first box, and I'll take the second.

line.b_kpn_ja.text: My win! I carry the first box, and you take the second.

line.c_pudlo_ty.text: Drag your box up into my new hollow, up there.

line.c_pudlo_lis.text: Hop! My box flies right into the hollow!

line.d_polki.text: Here is a big shelf, and there a little one. And two boxes of the store: a big one and a small one.

line.d_ojej.text: Oh no, the box is falling!

line.d_postaw.text: Drag each box onto the shelf that's just right for it.

line.d_polka_nie.text: That shelf doesn't fit that box. Big on big, small on small.

line.d_krzesla.text: Now the chairs for the guests. Point to the smallest chair, it's for Squirrel.

line.d_krzesla_nie.text: That chair is bigger. Look for the smallest one.

line.d_krzesla_ok.text: Yes, the smallest chair is just right for me!

line.d_impreza.text: The best house-warming! Every box, chair and cup is just right.

line.d_buty.text: I'll show you a game for home. Two shoes, a big one and a small one. Point to the bigger shoe.

line.d_buty_nie.text: That shoe is smaller. Look for the bigger one.

line.d_buty_tak.text: Yes, that shoe is bigger. I'll lay the small one on the big one: the big one sticks out all round!

line.d_pudlo_wiew.text: I'll put the big box on this little shelf. It'll be near the window!

line.d_pudlo_nie.text: That box is bigger than the little shelf, it sticks out on both sides. The big box on the big shelf, the small one on the small shelf.

line.d_pudla_ok.text: Yes! The big box stands on the big shelf, and the small one on the small shelf.

line.p_czapki_ok.text: Everyone has a cap that's just right: the biggest on Owl's big head, the smallest on mine!
